title: Solo or Find a Team, Create Build and Publish all in one. Tools and features built over 3 years of wanting to make it easier for anyone to create and publish games along with everything in-between.
author: TalkingPixelsStudio
selftext:
From finding testers to organizing your dev logs, patch notes and creating/managing license keys for your games. Not going to post a long advertisiment style post as I've got only 1 HOUR to actually play something for a bit so feel free to take a look and I'll respond to any questions/feedback yall have. Soon I'll be done setting up my servers to host multiplayer games (restricted to 100 players or less each game for now, building more which will replace the temporary ones) and after a bit longer on the closed testing for my free game engine and then were just down to polish on the game launcher and clients. 

All Free and I plan to build this around the community so your feedback/suggestions will always matter regarding what new features and add-ons we focus on. The Community Counsul will be a revolving board of users that, with the rest of the communities votes/feedback, help shape the platform as it evolves to fit the needs of the community.

  
[Talking Pixels Platform](https://www.talkingpixels.games)
